support: Straightforward help for face-down timing, plans, purchase restoration, and your files.
faqs: How do I start a focus session?
Choose or create an Activity, start the timer, and place the iPhone flat and still with its screen facing down. Studydown starts recording after it detects that position.
Why did the timer not start?
Make sure the iPhone is nearly flat, still, and Studydown is active. A steep angle or ongoing movement can prevent face-down detection.
How do I restore Lifetime Pro?
Open the Lifetime Pro screen and choose Restore Purchases while signed in to the Apple Account used for the purchase. Apple verifies the entitlement.
How do CSV and JSON files differ?
Basic CSV is available free for tabular records. Lifetime Pro adds a complete JSON backup and restore. A file is created only when you request it and goes to a destination you choose.
privacy: The Studydown app does not collect personal data. Focus records are processed and stored on your device.
privacy_sections: Activity names, focus sessions, summaries, weekly goals, Deadlines, and settings stay in local app storage. Studydown has no account or developer server.
Studydown reads device orientation and motion only as needed to detect when the iPhone is face down. Raw sensor readings are not kept, sent, or linked to you.
When you buy or restore Lifetime Pro, StoreKit communicates with Apple. Apple processes the transaction; Studydown does not receive your payment details.
CSV and JSON files are produced only when you request them. You choose where to save or share them, and that destination's privacy terms then apply.
If you email support, we receive the address and message you choose to send. We use them only to answer your request and do not sell them or use them for advertising.

This static site sets no cookies and loads no analytics, ads, trackers, or third-party scripts. GitHub Pages hosts the files and may process standard connection information under its own privacy terms.
